title: dillenia indica f. elongata
intro: Dillenia indica f. elongata, commonly known as the Elephant's Head or Elephant Head Tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Dilleniaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, as it has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dillenia indica f. elongata include its ability to act as an expectorant, a sedative, and an anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
